findings.message: passes an unvalidated dynamic destination to a network API
findings.remediation: Parse the destination, require HTTPS, and allowlist hosts and resolved IP ranges before making the request.
findings.impact: An attacker-controlled URL can make the plugin request internal services, cloud metadata, or attacker-selected hosts.

findings.message: constructs a regular expression from a non-literal value (possible ReDoS) (4 occurrences in this file)
findings.basis: OWASP Regular Expression Denial of Service Prevention
findings.remediation: Use bounded, allowlisted patterns and enforce input and execution limits for dynamic regular expressions.
findings.impact: An attacker-controlled regular expression can consume excessive CPU and deny service.
findings.attack_vector: A non-literal value is passed to RegExp without pattern or execution bounds.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: uses string concatenation or char-code construction to hide keywords (3 occurrences in this file)
findings.remediation: Use readable, explicit code patterns; avoid character-code obfuscation.
findings.impact: Character-code construction hides string literals from grep-based detection.
findings.attack_vector: String.fromCharCode() builds dangerous strings at runtime — evades static patterns.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: decodes obfuscated payload and executes it in the same file
findings.remediation: Remove all decode-and-execute patterns; they are strongly correlated with malicious behavior.
findings.impact: Decoded payload executed in same file — classic obfuscation-to-RCE pattern.
findings.attack_vector: Buffer.from(base64).toString() → eval() chain; the base64 payload is invisible to static review.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: invokes a file-system mutation API (2 calls in this file)
findings.remediation: Require explicit user approval and restrict mutations to an allowlisted workspace path.
